title: Billing journal, payments and allocations contract v1 (B1-B2; synthetic data only; ADR 0008 pending billing approval)

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code; must equal the tenant billing currency (422 currency_mismatch).

MinorUnits.description: Signed integer minor units. On journal lines debit is positive and credit negative.

Money.description: SHARED-CONTRACTS Money: explicit currency and integer minor units. Never a float.

SyntheticRef.description: Synthetic opaque external reference (check number, deposit, refund). Never real data.

SyntheticProcedureRef.description: C14 seam: a synthetic rendered-procedure reference until C14 drives charge posting.

SyntheticProcedureCode.description: Synthetic placeholder code only; no licensed code set is bundled (B-S4).

PayerRef.description: Synthetic payer reference until B5 coverage records exist.

ChargePost.description: B1 charge posting, the seam C14 will drive. Posts Dr patient_receivable / Cr production_revenue. A replacement names a fully reversed charge of the same patient and procedure.

Charge.description: Open responsibility and allocated amounts are derived from journal lines, never stored.

Balance.description: Derived from journal lines posted at or before asOf; never stored. balance = patientResponsibility - unappliedCredit (negative is a credit balance). Covers the patient merge set; merges never relink posted rows.

InstrumentRef.description: Synthetic opaque instrument for the synthetic provider only (B-S1 blocked-on-discovery). Never card data or a provider token.

PaymentRecord.description: Records patient money as a received fact (Dr undeposited_funds / Cr unapplied_credit). card_synthetic needs instrumentRef and calls the synthetic provider; cash and check must not carry one.

Payment.description: Allocated, refunded, unapplied and settlement amounts are derived from journal lines. Received is not settled; settlement is its own entry.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name (Area/Location); unknown zones are 422 invalid_time_zone.

AuthorizationRef.description: Synthetic reference of a recorded authorization (signature) fact. Used once per plan.

EvidenceRef.description: Synthetic reference of the signed-agreement evidence (no signature image is stored).

CardExpiry.description: Card expiry month (YYYY-MM); no other card data.

PlanCreate.description: B3 plan creation. Monthly installments split the contract total evenly (largest remainder to the earliest). The guarantor, when named, must be the current S5 guarantor.

PaymentPlan.description: Derived plan view (B3): balance, overdue, states and the schedule are computed at read time from the terms, the facts, the attempts and the journal; none is stored.

StatementGenerate.description: B4 generation: an audited snapshot of the guarantor accounts from the journal at the cutoff (millisecond precision). Delivery is E7.

StatementFreshness.description: Derived at read time from the snapshot and the journal; never stored.

Statement.description: A generated statement (B4): the stored snapshot, its digest check and the derived freshness.
